jobs.occupation: Business Analyst MS Dynamics 365 (ERP) Finance & Operations
jobs.description:
Are you a Business Analyst with experience in MS Dynamics 365 (ERP) Finance & Operations? Do you see yourself as the bridge between business and IT, with a strong focus on both processes and people? Then keep reading, because you might be exactly the person we're looking for! As an ERP Business Analyst, you play a key role in understanding and translating business needs into effective solutions.

 

• You take the lead in identifying and defining business needs.
• You advise on which improvements create the greatest value by analysing business context, high-level requirements and ROI.
• You provide business cases to support Business Partners and Project Managers in defining roadmaps and initiating projects.
• Together with the Application Architect, you define high-level solutions that contribute maximally to business objectives.
• You document your analyses clearly and accurately, using appropriate business analysis techniques.
• You manage priorities and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders and technical teams.
• You work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects and external partners.
• You support business stakeholders in decision-making and provide insights to maximise ROI.
• You are responsible for monitoring and safeguarding the achievement of initial objectives throughout project delivery.
• You are able to prioritise business needs across multiple stakeholders and domains.
What you need to succeed:
• You hold a higher education degree (preferably a Master's degree) and have at least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
• You enjoy acting as the bridge between business and IT.
• With strong analytical skills, you work in a structured, results-oriented manner.
• You are a team player, but you are equally comfortable working independently.
• You have a hands-on mindset and enjoy tackling complex challenges.
• You have experience with tools and systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Office tools), Confluence, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Jira.
• Experience and knowledge within Procurement are a plus.
• You are familiar with Agile methodologies, ITIL processes and BPMN modelling.
• You communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.
• You work from our Hasselt (Corda Campus) office at least one day per week, combined with remote working.

Are you an experienced Functional Analyst who enjoys working in a Scrum environment and are you eager to immerse yourself in a complex, long-term project? Do you also possess strong communication skills in Dutch, English, and a bit of French? Then we are looking for you! Within our Social Impact division, we are launching a new greenfield project for one of our clients active in pension fund management; think of complex calculations, no margin for error, etc. To help ensure the success of this project, we are looking for an experienced Functional Analyst to join our team. Are you ready to strengthen our team and contribute to a project that delivers real societal value?

• You capture and analyze business requirements and translate them into clear and actionable user stories.
• You act as the go-to person for questions related to analyses, developed user stories, customer requests, and development activities.
• You closely monitor the development process and are responsible for testing and validating delivered functionality. You also support and guide the customer during user acceptance testing.
• Shaping Digital Together: you collaborate closely with various stakeholders in a Scrum environment that works in two-week sprints. You actively participate in daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
What you need to succeed:
• You have several years of experience as a Functional Analyst within an Agile/Scrum environment and understand how to deliver value through iterative development.

For an international company active in the food ingredients industry, we are looking for a motivated Application Lab Assistant Bakery to join the Research & Development team in Vilvoorde. As an Application Lab Assistant Bakery, you will play an important role in the development and improvement of ingredients and applications within the bakery and fat confectionery industry. You will perform practical baking trials, analyse the results and support both existing projects and the development of new products. You will mainly work in a laboratory and pilot plant environment, collaborating closely with different technical teams. Thanks to your practical baking knowledge and analytical mindset, you will contribute to the development and commercialisation of innovative ingredients. Your responsibilities will include: 

 
• Preparing and conducting various baking trials and application tests on bench and pilot scale. 
 
•  
 Evaluating dough and bakery products in terms of processability, quality and machinability. 

 
•  
 Collecting, measuring and accurately analysing data during and after the trials. 

 
•  
 Preparing detailed technical and scientific reports documenting the results and findings. 

 
•  
 Supporting the development and improvement of existing and new product formulations and recipes. 

 
• Assisting in the preparation of technical datasheets, product information and presentations. 
 Supporting product demonstrations and contributing to technical presentations for customers. 

 
•  
 Ensuring that laboratory equipment and infrastructure are properly maintained. 

 
•  
 Following all applicable quality, food safety, EHS and maintenance regulations.

 
• You have a degree in baking or a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, combined with practical experience. 
 
• You preferably have at least 6 months of work experience as a baker or in a similar position. 
 
• You have good practical knowledge of baking processes and understand how dough and ingredients behave during processing. 
 

 
• You are able to evaluate dough in terms of processability and machinability. 
 Experience in product development, formulations and recipes is a plus. 

 
•  
 Knowledge of analytical techniques and experience conducting laboratory or pilot-scale trials are an advantage. 

 
• You have good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. 
 
• You are able to write clear reports and present results in a structured way. 
 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
 
•  
 You work accurately, have an analytical mindset and pay attention to detail. 

 
•  
 You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to take initiative. 

 
• You can work independently but also enjoy collaborating with a team. 
 
•  
 You are flexible and can easily adapt to changing tasks and priorities.

JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S POWERING PROGRESS
 

 
 

Building cities. Driving commerce. Fueling Progress. For over 100 years, Allison has powered the vehicles and technology that move our world forward. 
What powers us? Our employees. From the first person hired by James Allison in 1915 to the thousands across the globe who work for Allison today, we’re driving progress everywhere because we employ top talent worldwide. In both the Allison Transmission and Allison Off-Highway Drive and Motion Systems business units, our team strives to Improve the Way the World Works.
 

 
 

Learn more about this role and how you can begin 
 driving your career forward!

The Team Lead Design & Drafting leads the Design and Drafting team and is responsible for delivering high-quality engineering design solutions and lifecycle management of drivetrain and gearbox products. The role ensures that product designs meet requirements related to quality, reliability, manufacturability, sustainability and cost efficiency, while supporting the successful execution of new product development projects and engineering changes.
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities
 

· Lead, coach and develop the Design and Drafting team.
 

· Drive employee engagement, performance management and talent development.
 

· Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of design activities for new product development projects.
 

· Oversee engineering changes, product documentation and bill of material governance.
 

· Monitor team workload, resource planning and operational KPIs.
 

· Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality and project stakeholders.
 

· Drive continuous improvement, standardization and automation initiatives.
 

· Support design reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards and processes.
 

· Maintain service parts lists and support the complete product lifecycle.
 

 
 

Scope Factors
 

· Direct leadership of 4 employees in Brugge and indirect coordination of 8 employees in India.
 

· Responsibility for engineering activities supporting projects with an annual value of approximately EUR 2 to 3 million.
 

· Department budget responsibility of approximately EUR 0.5 million.
 

· Oversight of approximately 1,000 design changes annually.
 

· Management of approximately 500 service parts list updates per year.
 

· Support of 1 to 2 new product development projects annually.
 

 
 

 
 

 

Competencies and Behaviors

·        Strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

·        Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

·        Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple activities simultaneously.

·        Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

·        Organized and detail-oriented approach to work.

·        Collaborative team player with a customer-focused mindset.

·        Ability to work independently and make informed decisions.

 

Qualifications and Experience

·        Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent through experience.

·        Minimum 10 years of experience in gearbox design, drivetrain systems or a similar engineering environment.

·        Proven experience with CAD software, preferably PTC Creo.

·        Good understanding of manufacturing, assembly, quality and service operations.

·        Experience working with PLM and workflow systems such as Teamcenter.

·        Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

·        Fluent in English.

·        Good command of Dutch is an advantage; willingness to learn Dutch is required

Within the Cegeka Security & Networking division, we help organizations improve their cyber resilience through end-to-end cybersecurity services covering assessment and advisory, protection, detection and response, and recovery. To support the continued growth of our global Security Solution Presales team, we are recruiting a Security Presales Architect based in Belgium. As part of the global team, you will support both Belgian and international customers, collaborating across countries with sales teams, security specialists and delivery experts on local and international opportunities.

• You position and present Cegeka SOC, MDR and managed security services, clearly articulating customer outcomes, scope, operating model, service integration and value.
• You design security solutions across SIEM, XDR, endpoint, identity, cloud and threat detection, with Microsoft security technologies as an important part of the solution landscape.

• You respond to RFI, RFP and tender requirements, including solution descriptions, assumptions, service scope, effort and cost inputs, risk identification and compliance mapping.
• You develop customer-specific business cases, transformation roadmaps and commercial solution options in cooperation with sales, service owners, product management and delivery teams.
• You coordinate contributions from SOC, Architects, Advisors and other subject-matter experts to create one integrated customer proposition.
• You ensure a structured handover of the agreed solution, scope, assumptions, dependencies and commitments to delivery and operational teams.
• You act as a senior subject-matter expert and trusted security advisor, taking ownership of keeping your security expertise up to date through strategic vendor engagement, relevant certifications and continuous awareness of evolving cyber threats and technologies.
• You identify market developments, customer needs and competitive insights, and translate these into actionable feedback for service owners and product management.
• You contribute to reusable proposal content, value propositions, sales enablement and solution templates, and drive continuous improvement through standardization, automation and AI-enabled pre-sales tools and templates.
What you need to succeed:
• At least 7 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience in senior solution presales, security architecture, security consulting or a comparable customer-facing role.
• Proven customer-facing presales experience is mandatory. You can independently lead discovery, shape solutions, create and defend proposals, present to executive and technical audiences, and guide opportunities through complex decision processes.
• Strong practical knowledge of SOC and Managed Detection & Response services, including the ability to discuss use cases, operating models, onboarding considerations, integrations, service scope and customer responsibilities.
• Strong experience with Microsoft security solutions, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, …
• Experience with relevant strategic security vendors and ecosystems. Knowledge of technologies from vendors such as Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Cisco, Fortinet and Vectra is valuable. Experience with additional SIEM, XDR, endpoint, identity, Network, cloud security and threat platforms is an advantage.
• Good understanding of cyber threats, detection and response, incident handling, threat intelligence, security operations and the business value of managed security services.
• Ability to translate customer requirements and risks into an integrated security solution, service scope, roadmap and commercial proposition aligned with Cegeka’s managed services portfolio.
• Demonstrable experience with RFI/RFP responses, statements of work, assumptions, sizing and pricing inputs, presentations and customer workshops.
• Strong consultative communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, structure complex information, coordinate virtual bid teams and take ownership of security pre-sales deliverables.
• You are based in Belgium and can work flexibly from Cegeka offices, from home and at customer locations. You are willing to travel when required.
• You will be part of Cegeka’s global Solution Presales organisation. Your primary market is Belgium, while you will also support international teams and global customers and collaborate with colleagues across countries.
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is required, preferably in an IT-related field, complemented by relevant professional experience and security expertise.
• Fluent professional English is required. Professional Dutch is required for the Belgian market, French is a plus.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft Security certifications or comparable security credentials are considered strong assets.
